Could you please direct me to the professor or lab at Mahindra University handling summer research internships in graph neural networks or molecular graph learning? I am interested in applying for a summer research position and would appreciate any guidance on the application process.

Best regards,
Test Student

emails.subject: Invitation to speak on LLMs at Bangalore AI summit
emails.body:
Hi Rahul,

I am the lead organiser of a college AI club that runs a 1,500-attendee student AI summit each March at an engineering college in Bangalore. Your paper, Finding Inductive Loop Invariants using Large Language Models, caught my attention because it applies LLMs to program reasoning.

We are seeking expert speakers on applied ML or LLM topics for this year's summit. I wanted to invite you to speak at the event.

Would you be interested in presenting on applied machine learning or large language models at our student AI summit in Bangalore this March? If you are unavailable, could you kindly suggest any ML practitioners or researchers who might be interested?

Best regards,
Test Organiser

emails.subject: Sponsorship opportunity for your next tech event
emails.body:
Hello Gaurav Singh team,

Our annual technical fest attracts over 5000 students from 120 colleges, featuring 40 workshops and a 36-hour hackathon.

Given your experience sponsoring student tech events like Tech Fest, we believe a partnership could benefit both sides. We offer sponsorship options including event branding, workshop sponsorships, and hackathon prizes.

Could you please direct me to the person who handles sponsorships for student tech events at your organization? This will help us explore potential collaboration.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,
Test Organiser
